title: Service worker activate deletes the public-pages cache on every SW update
persona: New Android Chrome visitor wanting to install the PWA
steps: activate handler deletes every cache key !== SHELL
expected: Activate keeps current-version caches (SHELL and PAGES), deleting only old versions.
actual: Filter `k !== SHELL` also deletes sl-pages-v2. After any future SW update, cached / and /results are wiped until each is visited online again, so offline opens show the offline page. Not reproduced live (needs a new SW version); code reading only. Observed fine today: SW registers (scope /, activated), after visiting /, /results, /legal/terms they are cached and open offline; /slate, /edges, /account, /game/<id> show the offline page offline; caches hold no /api/ URLs and no paid pages (signed-in run too).
